prior_year_events.impact_description: Cargo account suffered losses arising from business written in 2014 leading to reserve strengthening

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate reported an overall aggregate prior-year reserve strengthening of GBP 4.4m (net of reinsurance) during 2015. This strengthening was driven primarily by adverse development in the Marine cargo account (losses on business written in 2014) and by the immature Professional Liability book where a detailed review led to higher reserves. No gross prior-year movement figure was disclosed; the reported GBP 4.4m is net of reinsurance.
raw_causal_phrases: Most lines of business are performing at or better than plan however there are two areas where we have experienced adverse development.
The marine account has suffered from a number of larger losses and in particular the cargo account has suffered from losses arising from business written in 2014.
This account has been restructured and the business written in 2015 is performing better than plan.
The second area is our professional liability book where due to the immature nature of this account we are building our data set supported by additional market development data.

We have supplemented the development data with a detailed review, using both internal and external resources, of material contracts and claims notified. This has led to a strengthening of the reserves held during 2015.
Overall on an aggregate basis, reserves strengthening of GBP 4.4m net of reinsurance were made to prior year reserves during 2015. In 2014 there was a reserve release of GBP 2.6m.
data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year reserve movement (movement in prior years) was presented. The report explicitly states a net (after reinsurance) prior year strengthening of GBP 4.4m; this NET figure has been used because no gross PYD was found in the movement note. A gross claims development triangle (gross amounts) is present and was captured; it could be used to compute a gross PYD but the report also contains potential distortions in development (large increases) so gross PYD was not calculated automatically. If a gross PYD is required it should be derived from the gross claims development triangle.
